a2hs.title: Add Andaman to your home screen
a2hs.lead: Open your privileges in one tap — no card needed
a2hs.ios1: Tap the Share button (square with an up arrow) in Safari’s bottom bar
a2hs.ios2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”
a2hs.ios3: Tap “Add” at the top right · the Andaman icon appears on your screen
a2hs.and1: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right of Chrome
a2hs.and2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
a2hs.and3: Tap “Install” · the Andaman icon appears on your screen
a2hs.lineTip: If you opened this in LINE, tap ⋯ and choose “Open in Safari” first

account.full: You can add up to 2 people

1.b: The ANDAMAN CLUB card is issued free of charge, one per home, for the owner and up to 2 household members the owner adds in the portal.

2.b: Only the owner and registered household members. The card and its benefits may not be transferred, lent or sold.

3.b: Show the physical card or the card in the portal before paying. The venue may scan the QR to check the card is active and may ask for ID. Benefits cannot be combined with other promotions unless the venue says so.

4.b: Benefits are offered by partner venues. The company may add, change or end benefits and partners; check the portal for current benefits. Venues are responsible for their goods and services.

5.h: Lost card or sale of the home
5.b: Tell our sales team and we will issue a new card; the old one stops working at once. When the home is sold, the card and benefits do not stay with the seller; the new owner receives a new card.

6.b: The company may suspend a card that is misused, for example used by non-residents or shown as an edited screenshot.

7.b: We use your data as described in the privacy notice and never share it with partner venues.

data.b: Your name, home, phone, your email and those of household members you add (used to send OTP codes), card handover, access history and remembered devices, to keep your account secure.

dont.b: We never share your data with partner shops — they only see the membership card on your screen — and we do not use your phone or email for marketing without your consent.

retention.b: OTP codes expire in 10 minutes · remembered devices expire after 90 days without use · access history is kept for 1 year

rights.b: You can access, get a copy of, correct, delete or object to the use of your data at privacy@andamanassetsolution.com. We reply within 30 days, and you may complain to Thailand's Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC).
